messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — following up on the post-launch spotlight with Coppergate. They shipped last week, want a short customer story + quote for launch post. Can we lock interview this week? :tada:
Trent Lopez: I can do Wed 10am PT or Thu 11am PT. Which works for Coppergate? I'll send invite once confirmed.
Ellie Ramos: Customer prefers Thu morning. Please include product folks + CS. I'll intro in email.
Maya Chen: Perfect. @Ellie can you intro and ask for a 15–20min interview? We'll capture 2 pull quotes and a photo.
Ellie Ramos: Intro sent — they asked about legal approvals for the quote text. Zoe, can you advise on turnaround for quote approvals? 
Zoe Patel: Quick heads up: we need a simple release + attribution consent. Standard turnaround 48 hours but can expedite if they sign the consent PDF. I'll attach redlines here.
Maya Chen: Attaching suggested quote snippets for them to pick from:

> "Redwood halved our inference latency and cut costs by 30% — game changer for our realtime features."

> "Switching to Redwood reduced infra headaches and gave us predictable latency at scale."

Trent Lopez: Nice. Can we include a short metric line like "50ms median latency"? Need customer OK.
Ellie Ramos: Coppergate liked the second quote but asked to soften the percent. Suggested edit: "reduced infra overhead by ~25%". Sent back to Zoe for legal.
Zoe Patel: Ok — updated consent + quote text in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/xxxx. Added a small attribution clause. If they agree, we'll need explicit signoff in email.
Maya Chen: Timeline check — interview Thu 11am PT, quote approval expected Fri EOD, publish next Tue to coincide with webinar promo. Is that feasible? :calendar:
Trent Lopez: Yes — I'll draft the launch post and webinar blurb after quote lock. @Maya can you draft the headline and 2 CTAs?
Maya Chen: Drafting now. Headline idea: "How Coppergate scaled realtime search with Redwood Inference". CTAs: "Read the brief" + "Join webinar".
Ellie Ramos: Customer confirmed signoff via email. Zoe — can you confirm legal greenlight so we can schedule assets? :+1:
Zoe Patel: Legal signoff sent. Keep the final quote verbatim from the email thread. I'll CC in the public copy review.
Maya Chen: Awesome — I'll assemble assets (headshot, 2 pull quotes, metric callout). Who's taking hero image? Trent?
Trent Lopez: I'll coordinate design. Will upload to Figma by Monday.
Maya Chen: Great. Last ask — web ops: include a small banner promoting the webinar on the case study page, link to signups. @Ellie will handle internal lead routing to SDR queue.
Ellie Ramos: Yep — routing set: all webinar signups from the case study go to SDR-A. I'll share the routing doc.
Maya Chen: Thanks team! Launch checklist: interview done, legal signed, assets in Figma, draft post + webinar blurb ready. Will post draft in #marketing for review Monday. :rocket:
LegalBot: Document signed by Coppergate (coppergate-inc@example.com) at 1998881399.
Maya Chen: Copy — closing thread and will ping for any last edits.
